description.zh: 工单号，您可以调用[CreateDataCorrectOrder](~~208388~~)、[CreateDataImportOrder](~~208387~~)、[CreateFreeLockCorrectOrder](~~208386~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en: The ID of the ticket. You can call the [CreateDataCorrectOrder](~~208388~~), [CreateDataImportOrder](~~208387~~), or [CreateFreeLockCorrectOrder](~~208386~~) operation to obtain the ticket ID.

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the tenant.

> : To view the ID of the tenant, log on to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the "View information about the current tenant" section of the [Manage DMS tenants](~~181330~~) topic.
